qa_flags.question: How should we think about incremental margins in Electrical Americas in 2026?
qa_flags.response_pattern: 管理層兩次表示現在談 2026 年利潤率「太早」，未給任何方向性數字，改推遲到 2 月正式指引再說

qa_flags.question: Given the strong backlog growth in Electrical Americas in 2025, how should we think about 2026 backlog growth?
qa_flags.response_pattern: 執行長明說「現在談這個還太早」，只給質化保證（創紀錄積壓、極高能見度）未給具體數字，同樣延後到 2 月指引

qa_flags.question: Do you see the data center market growing considerably faster than the 17% figure cited previously, with Eaton outperforming, given the shift to 800-volt DC architecture and the Boyd/Fibrebond additions?
qa_flags.response_pattern: 執行長詳細回答了每千瓦美元含量這個相鄰問題（更新至約 300 萬美元/MW），但未直接確認或更新 17% 這個成長率數字本身
